dedupe_keys.name: a convex micro grid based optimization model for planning of resilient and sustainable distribution systems considering feeders routing and siting sizing of substations and dg units

description: A Convex Micro-Grid-Based Optimization Model for Planning of Resilient and Sustainable Distribution Systems Considering Feeders Routing and Siting/Sizing of Substations and DG Units is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Saeed Behzadi. Highlights • New convex optimization model is proposed for distribution system expansion planning. • Optimal resilient microgrid based planning. • Routing and hardening of feeders, sizing and siting of substations and distributed generators. • Emission reduction as well as uncertainty of wind generations is also taken into account. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
